character_sheet: The Prince Adult is the royal heir full-grown, on the King's own rig at its own size: a body with a chest, back plates and six ridge spines, three four-segment necks each ending in a maned, spiked, jawed and toothed head, two clawed legs of thigh, upper leg, lower leg and foot with three double claws and a rear claw each, two ten-panel wings, and a seven-segment tail ending in two tip pieces and a spike (ModelThePrinceAdult.createBodyLayer, ModelThePrinceAdult.java:265-864). It is a TamableAnimal and a rideable flyer with 3000 HP, 0.36 speed and 100 attack (createAttributes ThePrinceAdult.java:180-188), follows its owner, is tempted by beef, wanders and looks at anything within 20 blocks (:136-142), avenges and defends its owner (:149-152) and hunts monsters (:157-178). Its activity byte is 0 on the ground and 1 in flight (no physics when flying, :219; the wings sound every 30 ticks, :225-235): it takes off on a 1-in-10 tick with prey in sight (:612-621), when its owner flies or is far (:242-246), or when hurt (hurt :278-310, a 20-tick guard). Flying (:740-790) it flies to just above its target with the attacking flag up and bites within ten blocks plus half the target's width (doHurtTarget :272) or, within about 24 blocks with its fire lit on a 1-in-2, shoots — a big fireball, a thunderbolt or an ice ball from six blocks ahead and 3.5 up when its head is aimed (shootSomethingAt :528-577); a tamed one below a quarter health flees. Ridden, it fires a canon trio on the strafe keys, cycling the shot per head (:409-413, :440-490), and bites for its rider within ten blocks (:498-517). Its three necks rise and fall on synced head extensions random-walked between 0 and 60 (:248-266). Tamed and left alone for 288000 ticks with the full-power-King option it becomes The King (:626-635, transformToKing :895-905); a diamond block tames and heals it and fills that counter (:914-918), an empty hand mounts it (:938-939), ice and flint and steel take and give its fire (:973-985). It has no natural spawn (it grows from the Prince Teen). Read it as the King in miniature: the vast slow wing-beat, three heads snaking on their own rhythms, and a real stride on the ground the King never has.
size_notes: Drawn at x1.0 of the rig (ThePrinceAdultRenderer.java:20, applied :30; shadow 1.2) on a 2048x2048 sheet (ModelThePrinceAdult.java:864 — the King's twin sheet); 6.25 x 10.25 block hitbox (ModEntities.java:578-580). The necks, wings, legs and tail are chains the code positions segment by segment — key the joints, never the positions.

behaviour: The Adult runs the King's model code at the royal wingspeed 0.65 with two states the King lacks: a ground state and a sitting pose. On the ground (DATA_ACTIVITY 0, ThePrinceAdult.java:66) the legs stride 45 degrees x the walking speed at 0.195 rad/tick and the wings flap 27 degrees x the speed at 0.2275; in the air the wings beat the same 27 degrees unscaled and the legs hang still; attacking, the wings beat 38 degrees at 0.4875, the claws flex 45 degrees and the legs kick 81 degrees at 0.39 whatever the speed; sitting stills the wings, the stride and the tail (ModelThePrinceAdult.java:883-1022).
The tail sweeps in a travelling wave that curls harder toward the spike — 14 degrees at 0.169 rad/tick at rest, 34 at 0.364 attacking (:988-1022).

Each head's pitch is its synced extension (0 to 60 degrees, random-walked, ThePrinceAdult.java:248-266) less 30; in the air the heads snake on their own yaw sines (left 0.1105, centre 0.0845, right 0.1235 rad/tick, 14 degrees; 45 degrees at 0.195 / 0.182 / 0.208 attacking) with the outer heads clamped never to cross the centre one, and their jaws work on three rates; on the ground they follow the look instead, two thirds of the look yaw and pitch to the heads on the side the look turns to and a third to the others (ModelThePrinceAdult.java:1024-1095, :1219-1577).
The body, chest, back plates and the front three ridge spines are static.

The bite (doHurtTarget, ThePrinceAdult.java:272), the shot (shootSomethingAt :528-577), the rider's canon trio (:440-490) and the transformation into the King (:895-905) are rolled by the AI or the player — nothing in the code fires an animation for them.

wishlist: in `fly`: the code beats the wings 27 degrees (ModelThePrinceAdult.java:886) but holds the body flat — add a body rise on the downstroke and let the tail trail the turn

in `walk`: the code's stride swings the lower legs twice the thighs (:962-963) with the wings flapping to the speed — add a body sway so the weight reads; the King never walks, so this clip is the Adult's own
in `attack`: a three-headed strike down on the target for the bite (ThePrinceAdult.java:764-768), the outer heads a beat behind the centre
in `aggro_idle`: the three heads whipping on their own rates (:1024-1039) with the claws flexing (:938-953): make the difference between the heads read
locked_bones_note: The design's section 6 ModelThePrinceAdult row (geckolib_migration_design.md:455): 'Body1 [3.5,3.5] @0.5; three *Head1 [1.6,1.6] @1; Lwing1/Rwing1 [4,1.4] @0.25; Tail1/Tail4/Tail7 [1.5,1.5] @0.25; segmented legs [1.2,3] @0.5'. Body1, Lwing1, Rwing1, Tail1, Tail4 and Tail7 resolve as written; 'three *Head1' is CHead1, LHead1 and RHead1. 'segmented legs' is not a bone name: taken as every segment of each leg — LThigh, LUpperLeg, LLowerLeg, LFoot and RThigh, RUpperLeg, RLowerLeg, RFoot (ModelThePrinceAdult.createBodyLayer; the claws stay visual). The row: 'Same rig family as King but its own exact main size and measured part envelopes.'
